nodes.label: Idempotency Keys in Ingestion Layer
nodes.rationale: Every external API request carries idempotency key (UUID). TimescaleDbWriter uses INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING to prevent duplicate writes during network retries.

nodes.label: Last Known Good (LKG) Cache
nodes.rationale: In-memory LKG cache for each critical data source (FRED/NY Fed). When circuit breaker opens, serve LKG value with X-Data-Age: STALE header.

nodes.label: Bulkhead Pattern (Executor Service Isolation)
nodes.rationale: Three dedicated executor pools: Critical Ingestion (FRED/NY Fed), High-Volume Ingestion (Finnhub WS), Computation Engine (ILI/Signals). Prevents single misbehaving service from starving core KPI processing.

nodes.label: ParticipationGovernanceService
nodes.rationale: Formal decision decomposition: Signal = g(s_t, h_t) * b(r_hat_t) where g is admissibility check (ILI status, proxy divergence, regime) and b is signal allocation logic. Makes decision logic auditable and testable.

nodes.label: Liquidity Stress Testing Module
nodes.rationale: Simulate extreme liquidity withdrawal scenarios based on 2015 Swiss franc cap removal model. Algorithmic traders withdraw liquidity during extreme stress causing rapid market deterioration.
